title: Markdown table parser with header validation
description:
Build a deterministic parser that reads a knowledge/*.md file, locates every markdown pipe table (`| ... |` blocks with a `---` separator row), and returns each table as { headers: string[], rows: object[] } keyed by column. CRITICAL: validate/normalize headers and expose them to callers so downstream mappers can guard against filename-lies (e.g. 62_Yacht_Builders_Data_Extraction.md opens with salary tables, not builders). Normalize header aliases (LOA/Length/Length (m); Builder/Shipyard; Year/Year Built/Delivered). Handle multi-table files, escaped pipes, and blank cells. Pure functions, no DB writes.

Part of Phase 1 (Ingestion). Deterministic-parser-first decision — no LLM. Best test fixtures: files 42 (gold-standard yacht schema) and 20 (10-col yacht/owner/builder table).
acceptance_criteria: Given a markdown file with N pipe tables, the parser returns N table objects each with headers[] and rows[] (row keys = normalized headers)
Header normalization maps known aliases (e.g. 'Length (m)', 'LOA' -> 'loa'; 'Shipyard' -> 'builder') to canonical keys
A table whose headers do not match an expected schema can be identified/skipped by callers (headers are always exposed)
Escaped pipes, blank cells, and files with zero tables are handled without throwing
Unit tests cover files 42 and 20 and assert correct row counts and sample field values
